taxonomy.name: Client Escalations
taxonomy.description: An unhappy client, a complaint about a placed worker, or a risk of losing the account.

taxonomy.name: Client Requests
taxonomy.description: New roles, headcount changes, and questions from client businesses.

taxonomy.name: Candidates
taxonomy.description: Applications, resumes and replies from job seekers.

taxonomy.name: Interviews & Scheduling
taxonomy.description: Calls or interviews with a real person that someone must attend.

taxonomy.name: Timesheets & Payroll
taxonomy.description: Hours, pay, and payroll questions from placed workers.

taxonomy.name: Job Board Alerts
taxonomy.description: Automated notifications from job boards and the ATS.

taxonomy.name: Vendors & Tools
taxonomy.description: SaaS product mail, trials, terms updates.

taxonomy.name: Security & Accounts
taxonomy.description: Sign-in alerts and account security notices.
